The stop is raised by the partially ported do_wear.c Ring_on() caller only because its RIN_LEVITATION arm reaches the missing trap.c float_up(); the source-backed implementation scope is the complete float_up() function and its production caller wiring. The current step is the ordinary-floor, non-trapped, non-swallowed, non-hallucinating, non-air-level branch that emits C's "You start to float in the air!" before the More wait. Later Ring_off() calls in this same recipe will expose the separate partial float_down() owner after this source unit lands.
